import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
scatter = axes[0, 0].scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                             c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='viridis', 
                             s=df['Physical Activity Level']/2, alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Stress Level\n(Size = Physical Activity)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[0, 0])
cbar.set_label('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=10)

# 2. Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation
occupation_metrics = df.groupby('Occupation').agg({
    'Sleep Duration': 'mean',
    'Quality of Sleep': 'mean',
    'Stress Level': 'mean'
}).sort_values('Sleep Duration', ascending=False)

x = np.arange(len(occupation_metrics))
width = 0.25
axes[0, 1].bar(x - width, occupation_metrics['Sleep Duration'], width, label='Sleep Duration', color='skyblue')
axes[0, 1].bar(x, occupation_metrics['Quality of Sleep'], width, label='Quality of Sleep', color='lightcoral')
axes[0, 1].bar(x + width, occupation_metrics['Stress Level'], width, label='Stress Level', color='lightgreen')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Average Score', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xticks(x)
axes[0, 1].set_xticklabels(occupation_metrics.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
axes[0, 1].legend()

# 3. Distribution of Sleep Disorders by BMI Category
disorder_bmi = pd.crosstab(df['BMI Category'], df['Sleep Disorder'], normalize='index') * 100
disorder_bmi.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=axes[0, 2], colormap='Set2')
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Percentage (%)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution by BMI Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 2].legend(title='Sleep Disorder', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
axes[0, 2].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 4. Correlation Heatmap
correlation_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 
                    'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[correlation_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr_matrix, dtype=bool))
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, square=True, linewidths=0.5, cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.8}, ax=axes[1, 0])
axes[1, 0].set_title('Correlation Heatmap of Health Metrics', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Daily Steps vs Heart Rate by Gender
for gender in df['Gender'].unique():
    gender_data = df[df['Gender'] == gender]
    axes[1, 1].scatter(gender_data['Daily Steps'], gender_data['Heart Rate'], 
                       alpha=0.6, s=50, label=gender)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Daily Steps vs Heart Rate by Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].legend()
axes[1, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 6. Age Distribution by Sleep Quality
df['Sleep Quality Group'] = pd.cut(df['Quality of Sleep'], bins=[0, 5, 7, 10], 
                                    labels=['Poor (1-5)', 'Average (6-7)', 'Good (8-10)'])
age_dist = df.groupby('Sleep Quality Group')['Age'].apply(list)
violin_parts = axes[1, 2].violinplot(age_dist.values.tolist(), showmeans=True, showmedians=True)
axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Sleep Quality Group', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Age', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 2].set_title('Age Distribution by Sleep Quality Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 2].set_xticks(range(1, len(age_dist) + 1))
axes[1, 2].set_xticklabels(age_dist.index, rotation=0)
for i, pc in enumerate(violin_parts['bodies']):
    pc.set_facecolor(plt.cm.Set2(i/len(age_dist)))
    pc.set_alpha(0.7)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
